items.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: That’s where I heard Kid Ory play.

ctx.x: I’ve had one parade since then. It did work. It was a lot more in the tradition. But I’d love to play something like that on a horse drawn wagon or something. Disneyland used to do
that. Their main parade at Disneyland was down Main Street in horse drawn wagons. That’s where I heard Kid Ory play.
You’ve done quite a bit of band leading. What’s the biggest headache in being a band leader? The biggest thing to surmount?
